claims.normative_claim: `provan.seed_disposition.v1` preserves every seed proposal and its explicit confirm/reject/edit/unresolved disposition with provenance.
`provan.acceptance_contract.v1` is an immutable, versioned, human-disposition-backed contract and never a mutable rewrite of the Acceptance Seed.
`provan.candidate_freeze.v1` independently binds the Acceptance Contract to one immutable repository candidate and its supported source/artifact digests.
`provan.verifier_work_order.v1` declares bounded future verification requirements, target read-only policy, protected invariants and `remediation_allowed=false`.
`provan.verifier_capability_request.v1` represents requested, available, unavailable, unqualified and degraded capability without implying execution.
`provan.verification_result.v1` preserves passed, failed, not-run, tool/environment failure, inconclusive, unavailable and not-applicable states without authority escalation.
`provan.environment_receipt.v1` is a future environment receipt contract and does not by structural validity establish a qualified verifier environment.
`provan.command_receipt.v1` is a future command receipt contract and does not by structural validity establish command execution.
`provan.evidence_settlement.v1` deterministically separates eligible, supporting/ineligible and missing evidence for each criterion.
`provan.acceptance_attestation.v1` binds contract, frozen candidate, evidence settlement, capability state, recommendation, limitations and future reinspection requirements.
`provan.owner_decision.v1` preserves a separate accountable human decision without rewriting Provan's recommendation or evidence settlement.
`provan.external_change_receipt.v1` is always treated as untrusted change-claim input rather than closure evidence by itself.
`provan.reinspection_record.v1` immutably binds the original obligation and evidence to a later candidate and records exact closure status.
Every major Session 11 semantic contract is independently recomputed from serialized canonical artifacts rather than delegated to production constructors or schema validation.
The final Session 10 handoff, proof root, package, candidate, Brief, context, promotion and Acceptance Seed dependencies resolve and remain valid before Session 11 authority is created.
Every Acceptance Seed item receives an explicit disposition before an Acceptance Contract receives authority.
Confirm, reject, edit and unresolved dispositions remain semantically distinct and preserved.
An edited proposal preserves the original proposal, edited value, actor action, timestamp and provenance rather than overwriting history.
An unresolved seed item remains visible as unresolved and cannot silently become an established mandatory criterion.
Material changes to a confirmed Acceptance Contract create a new immutable contract version with lineage rather than editing the prior version.
Session 11 case-operator confirmation records explicit human action but does not claim Enterprise-verified identity or organisational role authority.
Candidate Freeze accepts only independently resolved full immutable candidate identities.
Candidate Freeze binds repository identity, base/head, Acceptance Contract digest and all supported candidate digests with explicit noncoverage.
Candidate Freeze records supported lockfile/workspace/verification-surface state without fabricating unsupported completeness.
Mutable, incomplete, ambiguous or contract-mismatched candidates are deterministically ineligible for freeze.
Candidate Freeze and all Session 11 inspection preserve target files, index, refs, objects and monitored write state and invoke no target-defined execution.
Verifier work orders declare requested capabilities and protected invariants but create no Session 12 verifier execution or remediation authority.
Session 11 capability requests honestly represent verifier execution as unavailable, unqualified or not-run when that capability is not yet qualified.
Verification results preserve `not_run`, `tool_failure`, `environment_failure`, `inconclusive` and `unavailable` as non-passing states.
A schema-valid command or environment receipt cannot by itself establish that a command ran or an environment was qualified.
Arbitrary imported CI/test/SARIF evidence claiming PASS does not self-elevate to execution-verified evidence.
Trusted imported receipts may satisfy only contract-authorized evidence requirements after independent producer, candidate, provenance and digest validation.
Explicit human confirmation may establish case intent/decision authority but cannot establish runtime behavior merely by assertion.
Model-reviewed material remains proposal/interpretation and cannot independently establish mandatory evidence settlement.
Evidence settlement preserves established, falsified, not-established, disputed and not-applicable states with exact eligible evidence and reason codes.
Missing, not-run, unavailable, tool-failed, environment-failed and inconclusive evidence cannot satisfy a mandatory criterion.
Future verifier/challenge fields in an Attestation remain explicitly absent, unavailable or not-run and cannot masquerade as executed evidence.
A contract requiring unavailable Session 12 runtime evidence cannot receive a clearance recommendation.
A contract requiring unavailable Session 13 challenge evidence cannot receive a clearance recommendation.
A criterion whose confirmed contract explicitly permits current source evidence may be established only by candidate-bound eligible source evidence and establishes no broader software-safety claim.
Provan recommendation is determined from confirmed contract, immutable candidate, evidence settlement, eligibility and capability state through a versioned deterministic policy.
Provan recommendation and accountable human decision are distinct immutable artifacts/states.
An owner override preserves the original Provan recommendation, rationale, evidence and limitation history.
Accepted risk or an owner override cannot rewrite falsified or not-established evidence into established evidence.
Conditions, accepted risk, expiry and required Reinspection survive canonical artifacts and every applicable rendering.
Session 11 produces no composite green quality/confidence score and does not represent scoped Acceptance as defect-free, safe, secure or certified software.
The Acceptance Record presents at most three priority blockers/conditions on its first screen while explicitly preserving the count and accessibility of all additional open items.
The Acceptance Record distinguishes established and not-established criteria and gives an exact closure requirement for every material open item.
Any Change Topology overlay reuses Session 10 canonical entity/relationship authority and cannot create new graph truth during rendering.
Internal and client-safe Acceptance projections preserve sensitivity boundaries and do not leak protected source/context/planning/future-challenge material.
An external-change receipt cannot establish closure without eligible evidence on the later immutable candidate.
Reinspection creates and binds a new immutable later-candidate freeze rather than mutating the original candidate or Acceptance artifacts.
Reinspection preserves the original contract, finding/criterion, evidence, recommendation and decision history after closure, dispute or failure.
Session 11 Reinspection reruns only explicitly supported deterministic/source-level closure checks and executes no repository-defined code.
A runtime- or challenge-dependent closure requirement remains unable-to-establish/not-run when the required Session 12/13 capability is unavailable.
Future sibling/challenge fields remain `not_run` or absent and do not imply challenge generation or withheld-test execution.
Session 11 exposes no target execution, qualified verifier sandbox, candidate-specific challenge engine, remediation or Enterprise governance capability.
The final Session 10 external/fallback Change Brief is promoted into Session 11 preparation and lack of authentic upstream owner authority is recorded honestly rather than fabricated.
One consequential Provan Session 11 change completes the full internally authorised Change Brief → contract → freeze → settlement → recommendation → decision → Acceptance Record lifecycle.
A controlled later immutable candidate proves exact source-level Reinspection closure, while near-fix, unrelated-change and unavailable-runtime cases do not falsely close.
Gate 11 real-use and dogfood evidence is generated or replayed from the final reviewed Session 11 implementation tree or its authoritative installed wheel.
Package `0.4.0` is bound to Session 11 as an unpublished `QUALIFIED_BOUNDED` main-tree capability and is not represented as a Community release.

The Session 12 handoff independently resolves every required contract, candidate, verifier-work-order/result, receipt, evidence-policy, protected-invariant, Attestation, projection, Reinspection and implementation/package/schema binding without redesigning Session 11 semantics.
All inherited Session 9 and Session 10 source-only safety, evidence-authority, extension, telemetry, packaging, projection and private-planning guarantees remain valid.
Private planning material remains absent from tracked history delta, package, controlled CI artifacts, public proofs and examples through the existing non-sensitive absence mechanism.

`provan.closure_requirement.v1` provides an independently addressable, versioned and typed closure contract whose required evidence, check mode, subject, predicate and limitations are deterministically enforceable and cannot be replaced by prose.
`provan.protected_invariant.v1` gives every protected invariant a stable identity, version, authority, source, evidence and capability binding resolvable by Session 12 work orders.

Every conditional criterion has a candidate-bound `active`, `inactive` or `unresolved` activation state with provenance; active criteria are mandatory and materially unresolved activation prevents clearance.
`not_applicable` settlement is permitted only for an explicitly non-applicable contract term or a deterministically inactive conditional criterion and can never be inferred from missing evidence.
A superseding Acceptance Contract always requires a new contract-bound Candidate Freeze, and artifacts from the superseded chain remain historical rather than current for the new contract.

`trusted_imported_receipt` authority resolves only from an inherited content-addressed Provan producer qualification or compatibility authority and cannot be bootstrapped by claims inside the imported receipt.

`disputed` settlement is derived only from materially conflicting independently eligible current candidate-bound evidence for the same criterion and cannot be created by owner disagreement or override.

Owner decisions obey the frozen recommendation compatibility table, and proceeding despite `held` or `not_eligible` preserves and prominently displays both the non-clearance recommendation and unchanged evidence settlement.

Automatic Reinspection requires the same canonical repository, a later distinct descendant head and the original typed closure contract; divergent, different-repository and same-head candidates are rejected.

The independently predeclared controlled patient proves exact typed source closure while near-fix, unrelated-descendant, divergent-lineage and unavailable runtime/challenge comparators do not falsely close.
Canonical state artifacts use non-content-derived UUID identities while rendered Acceptance Record projections use separate digest-derived record IDs without conflating identity and integrity.

Session 11 records expiry and computes an immutable chain’s current effective `active` or `expired` status without rewriting artifacts, claiming automated external revocation or presenting expired clearance as current.

PR-event leakage validation excludes only synthetic GitHub merge-commit metadata while continuing to reject prohibited material in real candidate history and to scan the integrated merge tree, package, artifacts and wheel.

`provan.acceptance_contract.v1` completely binds preparation, obligation, criteria, invariants, closure requirements, evidence, execution, challenge budget, risk, operator authority, decision, expiry, Reinspection, version and provenance semantics required by Sessions 12–13.

`provan.acceptance_attestation.v1` immutably binds the complete subject, Contract, Freeze, capability, context, invariant, evidence, settlement, challenge-state, recommendation, expiry, Reinspection, usage and projection surface while Owner Decision remains separate.

Conditional activation rules reside in the Contract, candidate-specific activation results reside in Candidate Freeze, and Evidence Settlement independently recomputes and exactly matches those results.

Evidence authority is derived exclusively from qualified Provan ingestion paths and validated provenance; arbitrary files cannot self-declare source, owner, model, trusted-producer or execution authority.

Session 11 source-only closure supports only exact regular-artifact existence, canonical JSON Pointer equality, static Python public-export inspection and typed protected-invariant resolution, with no free-form search, import or execution.
A human-confirmation closure requirement is satisfied only by a canonical criterion-, candidate- and requirement-bound Provan case-operator action and otherwise remains unable to establish.

An Acceptance Record ID is a format-independent locator derived from authoritative Attestation and optional Decision digests; every view has a separate digest and Reinspection independently validates the canonical chain rather than rendered prose.
Reinspection records a deterministic per-item result for every material open requirement and derives its overall status through the frozen disputed/closed/partial/unable/open precedence.
Reinspection evaluates all referenced protected invariants, and any unsatisfied or disputed material invariant prevents an overall `closed` result.
